loragent-cloud.description: Cloudflare Workers Edge deployed Loragent MCP server with 174 agents

github.description: GitHub — repos, issues, PRs, commits, releases, Actions

filesystem.description: Filesystem read/write — scoped to project root

image-generate-fal.description: Image generation via Fal.ai — Flux Pro, SDXL, DALL-E 3 proxy. Use for: logo design, UI mockups, concept art, poster generation, hero images.

image-generate-replicate.description: Replicate — image/video/audio models. Fallback when Fal.ai is unavailable. Supports SDXL, Flux, Stable Video, MusicGen.

gif-create.description: FFmpeg-based MCP — video/GIF/animation processing. Use for: animated GIFs from video, sprite sheets, banner animations, Slack GIFs, loading animations. Also handles frame extraction, compression, format conversion.

browser-automation.description: Playwright browser automation — web scraping, E2E testing, screenshot capture, form filling, browser-based workflows. Use for: acceptance testing, visual regression, automated publishing workflows.

deploy-vercel.description: Vercel deployment MCP — deploy projects, manage domains, check build logs, promote to production, manage env vars. Requires workspace-guard confirmation for production.

deploy-railway.description: Railway deployment — services, databases, env vars, deployments, logs. For: Node.js, Python, Docker, static sites.

deploy-docker.description: Docker — build images, run containers, push to registry, manage compose stacks. Use for: containerized deployments, local dev environments, CI image builds.

database-postgres.description: PostgreSQL — query, inspect schema, run migrations. READ-ONLY by default; write ops require workspace-guard.

database-mysql.description: MySQL/MariaDB — for Shohoz legacy stack and Lorapok services.

firebase-admin.description: Firebase — Firestore reads/writes, Auth, Storage, Realtime DB. Used by loragent-database-updater for hivemind sync and loragent-gold-collector for skill storage.

slack-notify.description: Slack — send deployment notifications, error alerts, task completion reports to team channels. loragent-pr-specialist uses this for campaign updates.

email-send.description: Resend email — transactional emails, campaign sends. loragent-ads-manager and loragent-publisher use this for outreach.

openapi-caller.description: Generic OpenAPI caller — invoke any REST API defined by an OpenAPI spec. loragent-api-chef uses this to call/test endpoints.

git-ops.description: Git operations — commit, branch, merge, rebase, diff, stash. loragent-git-specialist uses this. All push/merge-to-main requires workspace-guard.

web-search.description: Brave Search — web research, competitor analysis, documentation lookup. loragent-research-paper-writer and loragent-marketing-strategy-manager use this.

skills-loader.description: Expose all skills/ directory SKILL.md files as MCP tools — enables cross-agent skill invocation without full file loading.
